name: Ruili
source: One of the five gynoids containing [url=/c7182]Ruili[/url]'s soul data. "Ruili" belongs to [url=/c7183]Liu Haojun[/url] - a memento of the rape and murder of Kong Ruili one year prior. [spoiler]Designed to look and sound like Ruili; Haojun is obsessive and overly protective of his gynoid. Haojun treats her like a princess.[/spoiler]
